channel.title: Permadeath Media devlog
channel.description: What we changed in our games and why.

item.title: Act 3, mandatory overtime, and a factory you can see
item.description: Freeing Plant 9 is no longer the end. Act 3 hands you a federation of worker co-ops to run, act 1 gets mandatory overtime, and the whole game gets pictures.

item.title: Nobody lost Hedy Plant. That was a bug in the balance, not in you.
item.description: 147 runs, 67 wins, 0 losses. What the first two days on itch.io told us about Hedy Plant's balance, and what changed.
